stories.title: Discours sur l'état de l'Union : Ursula von der Leyen réunira des grands acteurs de l'IA pour aider à "ralentir la course"

en.title: State of the Union address: Ursula von der Leyen to gather major AI players to help "slow down the race"
en.summary: The European Commission President made numerous announcements during her State of the Union speech in Strasbourg, including plans to convene major artificial intelligence actors to moderate competitive pressures in the sector.

stories.title: Le député Philippe Brun exclu de la primaire du PS et de ses alliés après des accusations de "violence", l'intéressé évoque sa "stupeur"

en.title: Deputy Philippe Brun excluded from PS primary and allies after "violence" accusations, concerned party expresses "bewilderment"
en.summary: The Eure deputy was suspended from the Socialist Party and barred from the left-wing primary following allegations of violence. Brun stated he is unaware of the specific charges against him.

stories.title: EN DIRECT - Présidentielle 2027 : «J’ignore ce qui m’est reproché», Philippe Brun réagit avec «stupeur» à sa suspension du PS et de la primaire de la gauche

en.title: LIVE - 2027 Presidential election: "I don't know what I'm accused of," Philippe Brun reacts with "bewilderment" to his PS suspension and exclusion from the left primary
en.summary: Deputy Philippe Brun was suspended from the Socialist Party due to violence allegations and excluded from the social-democratic primary's candidate list. He expressed confusion about the accusations against him.

stories.title: Ursula von der Leyen propose que l'Union européenne interdise les réseaux sociaux aux enfants de moins de 13 ans

en.title: Ursula von der Leyen proposes that the European Union ban social networks for children under 13 years old
en.summary: Von der Leyen proposed restricting social media access for children under 13 and limiting teenagers aged 13-15 to parent-controlled accounts with restricted features and usage time limits.

stories.title: Suspendu du PS, Philippe Brun écarté de la primaire à gauche en raison d’«accusations de violence»

en.title: Suspended from PS, Philippe Brun excluded from left-wing primary due to 'accusations of violence'
en.summary: Socialist deputy Philippe Brun was removed from the left-wing primary race following accusations of violence, despite having already submitted his endorsements, and is not among the five official candidates.

stories.title: EN DIRECT – Discours d’Ursula von der Leyen : la Commission européenne pour une interdiction des réseaux sociaux aux moins de 13 ans

en.title: LIVE – Ursula von der Leyen's speech: European Commission proposes banning social networks for under-13s
en.summary: The European Commission will present the Kids Act proposal on Thursday, which would ban social media for children under 13 and introduce limited accounts with parental controls for those aged 13 to 15.

stories.title: Réseaux sociaux : Ursula von der Leyen propose une interdiction aux moins de 13 ans dans l’Union européenne

en.title: Social networks: Ursula von der Leyen proposes ban for under-13s in the European Union
en.summary: The European Commission president proposed Wednesday banning social media for children under 13 and establishing restricted accounts supervised by parents or guardians for those aged 13 to 15.

stories.title: Cinq candidats participeront à la primaire à gauche pour la présidentielle, le député Philippe Brun exclu après des accusations de violences

en.title: Five candidates will participate in the left-wing primary for the presidential election, deputy Philippe Brun excluded following accusations of violence
en.summary: Olivier Faure, Raphaël Glucksmann, Jérôme Guedj, Emmanuel Maurel, and Ségolène Royal will compete in the left-wing primary on October 9-10 and 16-17, with Philippe Brun excluded due to violence accusations.

stories.title: Interdiction des réseaux sociaux : Ursula von der Leyen annonce une limitation « graduée » aux moins de 15 ans dans l’Union européenne

en.title: Social media ban: Ursula von der Leyen announces 'gradual' restriction for under-15s in European Union
en.summary: The European Commission president unveiled the Kids Act during her annual State of the Union address, proposing graduated restrictions on social media access for children under 15 and new obligations for platforms operating in the EU.

stories.title: Présidentielle : Philippe Brun, exclu du PS «en raison d’accusations de violence», ne pourra finalement pas se présenter à la primaire

en.title: Presidential election: Philippe Brun, excluded from Socialist Party 'due to violence accusations', ultimately cannot run in primary
en.summary: A Socialist elected official's candidacy for the left-wing primary was rejected both by his party and by the primary election's organizing committee following allegations of violence.

stories.title: Présidentielle 2027 : Philippe Brun, suspendu à titre conservatoire du PS, ne participera pas à la primaire à gauche

en.title: 2027 Presidential election: Philippe Brun, suspended from Socialist Party, will not participate in left-wing primary
en.summary: A deputy from Eure was provisionally suspended from the Socialist Party following a national board meeting on September 16, denying knowledge of allegations made by a former collaborator.

stories.title: Rachida Dati devant le tribunal correctionnel de Paris dans l’affaire Ghosn-Renault

en.title: Rachida Dati before Paris criminal court in Ghosn-Renault affair
en.summary: The former minister is on trial for passive corruption and passive influence peddling, accused of receiving 900,000 euros between 2009 and 2013 from former Renault-Nissan CEO Carlos Ghosn.

stories.title: « Une hausse vertigineuse » : d'ici à 2030, le coût de la charge de la dette va doubler pour la France

en.title: "A vertiginous increase": by 2030, France's debt servicing costs will double
en.summary: France's interest payments on its debt are projected to double by 2030, reaching 4% of GDP according to private economic research institute Rexecode, creating significant pressure on public finances at levels unseen since the interwar period.

stories.title: Viraj Aero monte en pression sur le moteur à vapeur

en.title: Viraj Aero steps up pressure on steam engine
en.summary: Toulouse-based startup Viraj Aero is developing steam technology to enhance aircraft engine performance, with studies suggesting potential fuel consumption reductions of up to 40% and engine lifespan extensions of 29%.

stories.title: « Des armes en orbite » : la déclaration de l’US Space Force fait réagir

en.title: "Weapons in orbit": US Space Force declaration prompts reactions
en.summary: The US Space Force announced on September 14 that it possesses weapons in space, triggering responses from China and Russia, while Space Force officials expressed ambitions to double the organization's size within five years.

stories.title: Drone abattu par l’Otan en Lituanie : une première

en.title: Drone shot down by NATO in Lithuania: a first
en.summary: NATO fighter jets from Italy shot down a drone of undetermined origin in Lithuanian airspace in an unprecedented incident as the alliance continues its air policing operations.

stories.title: Souveraineté : plusieurs alliés continuent de dépendre de télécommunications militaires des États-Unis

en.title: Sovereignty: Several allies continue to rely on U.S. military telecommunications
en.summary: The U.S. Space Force signed a third amendment to a joint funding agreement for its secure WGS satellite communications system in geostationary orbit. Ten allied nations contributed funding for the WGS-12 launch.
